status: PLANNING PARAMETERS of the direct-stack proposal; not evidence and not a tolerance allocation

k_plane.basis: reviews/da-01.md D3: MMS -02 -SV socket with TW-SM stacker closes at h = 12.8 mm. K F.Cu = adapter rear face - adapter mated height. Change it here; every plane, gap and clearance is re-derived

obstacle_model.basis: scripts/partition/README.md: 0.35 mm drawn-courtyard free-placement separation and 0.30 mm edge allocation; the same 0.30 mm is applied to through-hole pads on the opposite face and to holes. Tracks, zones and copper are not modelled

board_edge_margin_basis: scripts/partition/README.md 0.30 mm board-edge allocation; applied to every K-outline containment test of the measurements

K_probe_regions_mm.basis: Search regions (centre ranges) named on the plan page for the slot and K rear-header probes

probe_tab_top_basis: The first control-tab sketch on the plan page ended at y = 178; measure.py reports how far the SUB pair falls short with that tab

pin_templates.basis: Planning pin orders from the plan page. S = signal slot (source signals in source pin order; an unfilled slot is NC), G = AGND, R = rail. ST-10 fixes the real pin maps
pin_templates.signal_beside_return_note: Required where the plan page or DA-01 D3 states the rule (EL/P: 3 signals, 2 AGND, 3 rails, each signal beside an AGND). A 1x5 adapter pair with four signals and one AGND cannot place every signal beside a return; check.py reports those signals
pin_templates.two_row_index_order: A two-row pin map lists index i at column i // 2, row i % 2. Two positions are adjacent in the same column (other row) or in the same row (next column)

sub_toggle.basis: Owner decision Q2 (SUB toggle); the plan reuses the three-position toggle already fitted on P. Its footprint geometry is copied from an existing P instance at rotation 0

enclosure_depth_basis: reviews/da-01.md D3: depth target about 40 mm (decided); the plan page 34 mm case is reported as a second row and is not a check

rows.basis: reviews/da-01.md D3: EL joins P on six double-row 2x4 pairs; every other family is single row

el_rails_basis: reviews/da-01.md D3 and the ST-04 re-brief: each 2x4 EL site carries all three rails, 18 rail contacts on EL
drop_in_basis: Families whose halves replace a GH header in place and must lie inside its courtyard. The EL-to-P 2x4 is a new pattern; it is checked as must-be-clear instead
must_be_clear_basis: reviews/da-01.md D3: the EL joint is decided; a courtyard-level conflict of its 2x4 halves is an error with its penetration depth, not a declared blocker
removed_carriers_basis: design/stack/mechanics/README.md supports table (ST-03): the seam cradle, its lips and both cross-members GO; DA-01 D3 accepts it for the y = 165..167 member

el_relief_holes.basis: reviews/da-01.md D3: the stacker tips pass the CLT socket by 0.65 mm, so EL has eight relief holes per site, one per pin of the 2x4 at 2.00 mm pitch and row spacing. The 1.0 mm diameter is a PROVISIONAL planning value (0.50 mm square pin); the socket print (ST-01b) fixes it

el_pair_heights_mm.basis: reviews/da-01.md D3: TW-04-02-L-D-170-SM body top 4.32 mm, CLT 2.29 mm, tip 7.85 mm above P F.Cu, EL front height 1.75 mm

el_pot_passage_basis: reviews/da-01.md D4: the 18 EL pot passages grow from 6.3 to 6.8 mm; EL board features, not panel apertures

stacker_rule.basis: reviews/da-01.md D3: stacker "A" <= gap - 4.50 - 0.80 mm, rounded down to 0.005 in (0.127 mm); socket seated height 4.50 mm

fixings.reach_basis: reviews/da-01.md D4: every pair lies within 40 mm of a post or tie post
fixings.kept_support_basis: design/stack/mechanics/README.md supports table (ST-03): 12 supports become tie posts
fixings.provisional_tie_status: PROVISIONAL: reviews/da-01.md D4 sites "near" these coordinates; ST-08 fixes them and lists the part moves

adapter_standoffs.basis: reviews/da-01.md D2 closing table: two new standoffs per adapter (O1, O3, O5) to K. The 5.0 mm keep-out (hole, screw head and standoff body on both boards) is a PROVISIONAL planning value; ST-08 fixes the sites and the hardware
adapter_standoffs.diagnostic_basis: Smaller keep-outs are searched for diagnosis only (2.2 mm is the bare support hole); the check uses keepout_diameter_mm
